curated.tagline: Interactive Brokers portfolio dashboard with real-time data visualization
curated.description: Custom portfolio monitoring dashboard that connects to Interactive Brokers' Client Portal API for real-time account data. Displays position-level P&L, sector allocation pie charts, historical equity curves, and trade execution logs using interactive Plotly visualizations. Built as a Python application with automatic data refresh and configurable alert thresholds for position size limits and drawdown warnings.
